product_overview: BreathWise is a medical imaging platform that helps users and doctors analyze chest X-ray images with AI, returning diagnosis confidence scores, heatmaps, and report exports. The system includes a Flutter mobile app, a Django backend for user and patient data, and a FastAPI inference service for model predictions.
core_goals: Provide secure user registration, login, logout, and profile management
Support password reset workflows for account recovery
Enable storage and retrieval of patient-related diagnostic history and uploaded X-ray data in the backend
Deliver AI-based chest X-ray analysis with confidence scores for key conditions
Generate interpretable heatmaps and downloadable diagnostic reports for sharing and review

features.name: User Authentication & Profile API
features.description: Allows users to register, authenticate, manage sessions, view their profile, and recover access through password reset.
user_flows: POST /api/register/ with valid user details -> Receive 201 with created user account -> POST /api/login/ with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT access and refresh tokens -> GET /api/profile/ with access token -> Receive 200 with current user profile
POST /api/register/ with an email that already exists -> Receive 400 with validation error indicating duplicate account
POST /api/login/ with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 with authentication error -> GET /api/profile/ without a valid token -> Receive 401 unauthorized

POST /api/password-reset/ with a registered email address -> Receive 200 with reset request confirmation -> POST /api/password-reset/confirm/ with valid reset token and new password -> Receive 200 confirming password update

POST /api/password-reset/ with an unknown email address -> Receive 404 or 400 with reset request failure -> POST /api/password-reset/confirm/ with an expired or invalid token -> Receive 400 with token validation error
POST /api/logout/ with a valid refresh token -> Receive 200 confirming logout and token blacklist -> GET /api/profile/ with the same token -> Receive 401 unauthorized after session termination
